title: Deep Learning for Short-Term Voltage Stability Assessment of Power Systems
citation: Meng Zhang, Jiazheng Li, Yang Li, Runnan Xu. Deep Learning for Short-Term Voltage Stability Assessment of Power Systems. arXiv:2102.02526, 2021 (journal reference: IEEE Access 9 (2021) 29711–29718).
relevance_justification: Direct ML for short-term voltage stability assessment from post-disturbance dynamics. Provides a concrete training pipeline with label generation (semi-supervised clustering) and an LSTM-based real-time stability status model, matching the transient/dynamic stability prediction goal.

title: Transferable Deep Learning Power System Short-Term Voltage Stability Assessment with Physics-Informed Topological Feature Engineering
citation: Transferable Deep Learning Power System Short-Term Voltage Stability Assessment with Physics-Informed Topological Feature Engineering. arXiv:2303.07138, 2023.
relevance_justification: ML for short-term voltage stability with topology-aware and physics-informed features derived from raw PMU data, designed to transfer across grid topologies. Maps directly to stability feature engineering under topology change.

title: Transient Stability Analysis with Physics-Informed Neural Networks
citation: Jochen Stiasny, Georgios S. Misyris, Spyros Chatzivasileiadis. Transient Stability Analysis with Physics-Informed Neural Networks. arXiv:2106.13638, 2021.
relevance_justification: PINN-based transient stability assessment that embeds power-system DAE structure into training via residual losses. Ideal for the math-first stability regularization template.

title: Lyapunov-Regularized Reinforcement Learning for Power System Transient Stability
citation: Lyapunov-Regularized Reinforcement Learning for Power System Transient Stability. arXiv:2103.03869, 2021.
relevance_justification: Constrained/stabilizing RL that learns a neural Lyapunov function and penalizes Lyapunov condition violations. Directly supports Lyapunov-structured losses and ML-based stability control.

title: An Interpretable Power System Transient Stability Assessment Method with Expert Guiding Neural-Regression-Tree
citation: An Interpretable Power System Transient Stability Assessment Method with Expert Guiding Neural-Regression-Tree. arXiv:2404.02555, 2024.
relevance_justification: Interpretability-focused transient stability ML using an expert-guiding neural regression tree. Useful to teach how to connect learned predictors to physically plausible decision rules.
